name: LG Home Appliances
legalEntityNote: LG Electronics Inc. operates the home-appliance business through its Home Appliance Solution Company. Country subsidiaries, factories, importers and warranty providers can hold narrower regional roles; other companies within the wider LG group are not automatically appliance manufacturers or contract parties.

ownership.summary: LG Home Appliances is operated by LG Electronics Inc. through its Home Appliance Solution Company. LG Electronics is affiliated with the wider LG group, but the appliance operating company, its business division, regional sales subsidiaries, physical factories and local warranty entities are distinct. ThinQ, ThinQ AI and CordZero are product or platform names rather than separate appliance companies.

productPortfolio.name: Kitchen and refrigeration appliances
productPortfolio.positioning: Refrigerators, cooking appliances and dishwashers combine broad household coverage with selected premium and connected features.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify regional dimensions, voltage, installation, energy labels, connectivity and service parts by exact model.

productPortfolio.name: Laundry and garment care
productPortfolio.positioning: Washers, dryers, WashTower systems and Styler products form a central part of LG's home-appliance range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Tennessee evidence is specific to named washer production; origin, warranty and installation remain model- and market-specific.

productPortfolio.name: CordZero floor care
productPortfolio.positioning: CordZero spans stick, robot and selected canister vacuum formats with docking and automation features.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Compare docking architecture, batteries, bags, filters, app functions, radio approvals and after-sales availability.

productPortfolio.name: ThinQ connected services
productPortfolio.positioning: ThinQ links selected LG appliances with monitoring, automation and AI-assisted functions.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm supported country, account terms, data processing, cybersecurity support and offline operation before procurement.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: LG identifies Changwon Smart Park in South Korea as a production base for home appliances and describes it as a World Economic Forum Lighthouse Factory.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Match a product family and model to factory and origin documents rather than applying the site evidence to all LG appliances.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: LG's official Tennessee announcement defines the Clarksville facility around washing-machine production for the U.S. market.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Check the exact model, production label, origin statement and shipment batch before making a U.S.-manufacturing claim.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: LG Electronics operates global production and regional business entities across multiple appliance categories.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company network, not exact-SKU manufacturing proof
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Require manufacturer, factory, exporter, importer and engineering-change documentation for each sourced appliance.

marketsChannels.evidence: LG sells appliances through country websites, direct ecommerce in selected markets, authorized retailers, installers and service networks.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm authorized territory, channel rights, installation responsibility and local warranty before purchase.

marketsChannels.evidence: Regional LG Electronics subsidiaries can serve as sales, import or support entities under local legal notices and product documents.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Retain the invoice, importer label, compliance declaration and warranty identifying the responsible entity.

marketsChannels.evidence: CordZero assortments and ThinQ features vary across countries and product generations.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Validate model suffix, app region, consumables, accessories and service stock in the destination market.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: LG combines a broad major-appliance portfolio, credible smart-factory investment, ThinQ services and a multi-format CordZero floor-care range. Buyers still need to separate LG Electronics from the wider group and match each model to its regional seller, factory evidence, importer and warranty provider.
